note: VELDO-0230 AC3 (Telegram 38878): the evaluation of every new capability a newer agent CLI brings. Each is granted when useful and safe, off only when it breaks a named written rule (rules), or not applicable when it does nothing in Veldo's setup, each with its reason. python3 .veldo/qualify.py copies the decision of every new item it finds into the qualification record and its output; an item with no decision here is listed as unevaluated and is not granted. Nothing new ever blocks a launch. Evidence: proof/VELDO-0230/new-capabilities-0.166-2.1.317.md.

rules.VELDO-0040 AC1/AC3: isolation: a worker and every descendant run in the run's own contained group, and stop ends the whole group; nothing outlives the run
rules.VELDO-0042 AC1: isolation: each run works in its own isolated clone and writes nowhere else
rules.VELDO-0062 AC1: credential handling: each invocation authenticates only with the subscription login of the account its dispatch recorded
rules.VELDO-0062 AC2: usage: each invocation checks and reserves its usage allowance before launch
rules.VELDO-0127 AC4: capabilities: nothing loads unless the role lists it; the tools at launch equal the role's, compared on the wire
rules.VELDO-0156 AC1: profile sources: every Codex profile source is off; the account profile supplies only the login, no plugin or skill source
rules.VELDO-0160 AC3: no unreviewed network or file access: a call whose effect leaves the run's clone and host session is outward and asks the owner
